events.verdict: Brown (LAC) legally contests the driving shot attempt by Tatum (BOS), who extends his leg to create the marginal contact.
Brown (BOS) initiates contact with Jones Jr.'s (LAC) right arm, which affects his play at the basket.
Following the foul call on Brown (BOS), White (BOS) is assessed a technical foul for the contact to Jones Jr.'s (LAC) head/face.
Brown (LAC) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Jones Jr. (LAC) reaches in and initiates contact with Brown's (BOS) right arm, which affects his post shot attempt.

Springer (BOS) moves alongside of Porter Jr.'s (LAC) path to the basket and legally contests the driving shot attempt. Additionally, White (BOS) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact with Porter Jr.
Brown (BOS) illegally hooks his arm around Mann's (LAC) side.
Brown (BOS) steps out of bounds while in possession of the ball.
Brown (BOS) attempts to split the defenders and the ensuing contact with Brown (LAC) is marginal.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on the Celtics pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Jones Jr. (LAC) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds and play resumes with Boston possession.
Brown (BOS) legally contests Porter Jr.'s (LAC) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Brown (BOS) initiates contact to Coffey's (LAC) body that affects his driving shot attempt.
Jones Jr. (LAC) briefly places a hand/arm on Queta's (BOS) body and the contact during his shot attempt is marginal.
Porter Jr. (LAC) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
